name: agent-memory
description: Persistent, searchable Agent Memory with global/project scopes, compiled recall, graph links, pathfinding, health/prune tools, and a local dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent scoped memory with recall, graph tools, and a dashboard
interface.longDescription: A persistent memory plugin for Codex. It stores durable global preferences and project-specific workflows, supports deep memories, lite indexes, automatic/manual graph links, graph-expanded query, memory pathfinding, graph health/prune maintenance, semantic search when embeddings are configured, lazy no-op reads for uninitialized projects, model-gated writes, an interactive init flow for OpenAI API credentials, and a local read-only dashboard via agent-memory view.
